post.description: Creates a post in your Missive workspace.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

posts.description: Top-level post object required by the Missive posts endpoint.

posts.username.description: Name of the post author used instead of the API token owner's name.

posts.usernameIcon.description: Image URL of the post author used instead of the API token owner's avatar.

posts.conversationIcon.description: Image URL used as the icon in the conversation list.

posts.conversationSubject.description: Subject for a new conversation created by the post.

posts.conversationColor.description: Conversation color as a HEX code or one of good, warning, or danger.

posts.text.description: Main message of a post as plain text.

posts.markdown.description: Main message of a post formatted with Markdown.

posts.notification.description: Notification object with title and body keys used to render a notification.

posts.attachments[].description: Array of attachment objects for the post.

posts.references[].description: References used to append the post to an existing conversation.

posts.conversation.description: Conversation ID to append the post to an existing conversation.

posts.organization.description: Organization ID used to scope or link the conversation.

posts.team.description: Team ID used to link the conversation to a team.

posts.forceTeam.description: Pass true to force a new team even if the conversation is already in another team.

posts.addUsers[].description: User IDs that should get access to the conversation. Requires Organization when provided.

posts.addAssignees[].description: User IDs to assign to the conversation. Requires Organization when provided.

posts.addSharedLabels[].description: Shared label IDs to add to the conversation.

posts.removeSharedLabels[].description: Shared label IDs to remove from the conversation.

posts.addToInbox.description: Pass true to move the conversation to Inbox for everyone with access.

posts.addToTeamInbox.description: Pass true to move the conversation to a team inbox. Requires Team when provided.

posts.close.description: Pass true to close the conversation for everyone with access.

posts.reopen.description: Pass true to keep a closed conversation closed after adding the post.

post.description: Creates a response in your Missive workspace.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

body.description: HTML string containing the response content

organization.description: Organization ID string. Either organization or user is required, but not both.

sharedLabels[].description: Array of organization label ID strings

post.description: Creates a task in your Missive workspace.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

organization.description: Organization ID. Required when using team, assignees, or add_users.

team.description: Team ID. Either team or assignees is required for standalone tasks.

assignees[].description: Array of assignee user IDs. Either team or assignees is required for standalone tasks.

dueAt.description: Unix timestamp for the task due date.

subtask.description: Whether this task is a subtask of a conversation.

conversation.description: Parent conversation ID. Required when subtask is true.

references[].description: Array of references used to find or create the parent conversation.

conversationSubject.description: Subject for the parent conversation when creating via references.

addUsers[].description: Array of user IDs to add to the parent conversation.

addToInbox.description: Move the parent conversation to Inbox for everyone with access.
